title: Director of Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC)
summary: A director of GRC leads technology governance, risk and compliance for a large company or global capability centre. They own the control framework, run SOX, ISO 27001 and SOC 2 programmes, manage third-party cyber risk, coordinate audits and lead a team of GRC managers and analysts.
dailyDuties: Own the control framework and GRC tool set-up
Plan and coordinate SOX, ISO 27001 and SOC 2 audits
Review top technology and cyber risks with owners
Oversee vendor and third-party cyber risk reviews
Report compliance status to leaders and the audit committee
Lead and grow a team of GRC managers

skills.expectation: Own the GRC framework, policies and ISMS
Run SOX, ISO 27001, SOC 2 and PCI DSS programmes
Run technology and cyber risk assessments and the risk register
Run vendor and third-party cyber risk
Coordinate internal, external and regulator audits
Own the control framework and control testing
Lead a large GRC team with managers
Work with IT, audit, legal and business owners
Map controls to RBI, SEBI and CERT-In rules
Report compliance status to the audit committee
Show top risks as likely loss
Cover DPDP Act controls with the DPO

certifications.why: Common for leaders from IT audit.
Listed as a plus in posts.
